consensus_findings.description: The revision-5 lifecycle contract now separates timestamp-free setup intent, active ownership, retention, indeterminate provisioning, quarantine, and append-only recovery audit while preserving exact generation and controller fencing at every mutation boundary.

Autopilot recovery now validates derived identity before I/O, authorizes present and pending writes against the live registry fence, uses generation CAS and durability barriers, and permits removed-checkout recreation only at the exact fetched checkpoint tip.
The authoritative prerequisite preflight is a managed shared-feature root package whose owned scheduler completion barrier records and verifies exact feature HEAD before dependent worktree creation.

Delivery routing preserves immutable discovery evidence, current classification, active operator disposition, and append-only record, honor, and invalidation history while rejecting overrides for clear classifications.

The eight-package DAG assigns every mutating launcher, sync point, registry projection, generated mirror, contract fixture, and quality gate to an explicit non-overlapping implementation surface with test-first ordering.
